theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_line_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (w : Eucl n), (∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 (Φ w), LipschitzOnWith K F V) → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → DifferentiableAt ℝ (F ∘ Φ) w → ∀ s : Eucl n, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => F (Φ w + t • fderiv ℝ Φ w s)) (fderiv ℝ (F ∘ Φ) w s) 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
